pr_title: feat: allow options in automatic screenshots
pr_body:
Closes #9983 

Allowing Automatic Screenshots in `PlaywrightTestConfig` to have `fullPage` & `omitBackground` as optional parameters.

issue_context.title: [Feature] Allow custom options when making screenshots with Playwright Test (e.g. fullscreen)
comments: In my case the failure screenshot that is not full-page, does not give the team much debug info, thus I would love this feature to be implemented.

hey! do you consider this doable in near future?
also, right now there's no way to configure custom path to SS with test runner config (edit: probably the best solution would be to provide a function which returns string and has testinfo or testpath as parameter). it will also be very helpful (e.g. for PublishTestScreenshot task on azure devops)
So this collects feedbacks for 3 months already. Is there a way to push this forward?

> So this collects feedbacks for 3 months already. Is there a way to push this forward?

Also adding a comment here to see if there is a way to push this forward, this will be really useful in our company to see some screenshot errors that otherwise you can't see (full page = full screenshot information)

I'm watching this issue, with high expectations, whenever I see a notification about it. 
In my project, we manage to live without it, but from time to time it's really annoying to not have a full page screenshot.

Any updates regarding this? I would like to add to the Feature Request, the possibility to see the URL at the moment of the taken screenshot, as that would add even more visibility to the screenshot error, with a full page view and the URL of that page

None of my business really, but if you cannot wait for this feature it might be worth implementing it yourself (or one of your colleagues) and submitting it as a PR, in open source spirit. I think this is one of the easier enhancement requests.

review_comments: I think this snapshot file missing from the PR.
Is one screenshot enough to be added? `screenshot-grid-fullpage-playwright-test-win32.png` is the one generated when running the tests locally, added just that one

It seems that the `Config` type from `'./stable-test-runner'` (the one from [the file you mentioned](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/main/tests/playwright-test/playwright.config.ts)) does not have a `snapshotPathTemplate` parameter.

That's right! I have [just rolled](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/commit/d294c5da33dfe60bca2b76ca6893969002cbd62e) `stable-test-runner` to the new version and landed `snapshotPathTemplate`. You should be good after rebase.
Thanks @dgozman ! I have just updated the snapshot file.
@dgozman I also added a new `screenshot` property in `PageWorkerFixtures`

In addition to this change, please also update the [api docs here](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/main/docs/src/test-api/class-testoptions.md?plain=1#L191-L200). Take a look at [the similar `trace` option here](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/main/docs/src/test-api/class-testoptions.md?plain=1#L221-L237) for an example.
